script_a:
INT. BANK VAULT - NIGHT
KOBINA (30s, intense) picks the electronic lock. Sweat drips onto his screen.
KOBINA
Three seconds. If the security grid cycles, we're trapped.
ABENA (20s, sharp) monitors the radio chatter.
ABENA
Guards are moving to the west wing. Hurry up!
The vault door clicks. Green indicator lights flash on.

script_a:
EXT. MAKOLA MARKET - DAY
Rain pours over blue tarpaulins. MAMA ESI counts stacks of Ghanaian Cedi notes under a kerosene lamp.
MAMA ESI
The rain always brings the dishonest buyers. Keep your eyes on the spice bags.
KWESI nods and tightens his apron.
script_b:
EXT. MAKOLA BAZAAR - DAY
Heavy rain falls on blue plastic covers. MOTHER ESI calculates piles of currency notes beneath an oil lantern.
MOTHER ESI
Downpours always attract deceptive customers. Watch the bags of spices carefully.
KWESI agrees and fastens his apron.

script_a:
INT. COMMAND DECK - FUTURE
CAPTAIN VANE stares at the orbital radar monitor.
CAPTAIN VANE
Initiate full sub-light dampener shields before entering planetary orbit.
LIEUTENANT TANYA
Shields active at ninety percent power, sir.
script_b:
INT. HISTORICAL ARCHIVE - 1920
PROFESSOR ARMITAGE opens a dusty leather manuscript.
PROFESSOR ARMITAGE
The ancient hieroglyphs describe a buried temple south of Cairo.
EDWARD
Shall I prepare the camels for tomorrow's expedition?

script_a:
INT. LECTURE HALL - MORNING
Dr. Mensah writes differential equations on the chalkboard. Students type feverishly on laptops.
DR. MENSAH
Remember that assignment submission closes tonight at midnight sharp. No extensions.
YAO whispers to SAMIRA.
YAO
Did you finish part three of the algorithm problem set?
script_b:

YAO (sotto voice to SAMIRA)
Have you completed question three of the algorithm assignment?
DR. MENSAH (at the chalkboard)
Assignment portals lock at midnight tonight with zero exceptions.
